# Replica Recon , reverse-engineer any app into a recon map from public sources

Curated by Skill Harbor: the first step of the 11-skill Replica pack: reverse-engineer any app into a recon map you can actually build from. It inventories every screen with its states, traces user flows click by click, lists repeated components, infers the data model with evidence and confidence levels, and scores everything into a feature matrix, then sizes the project honestly (a weekend, a few weeks, a quarter, or rescope it). by @Jakeschincariol, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: strictly clean-room: public sources and your own account only, no scraping, no source code, no private APIs, and it lists upfront what cannot be cloned (licensed content, networks, regulated licences). Everything downstream in the pack builds on this map, so a rushed recon means a bad clone. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via GitHub.
